$schema.description: Editor hint only; ignored by the loader.

id.description: Always "game": there is one game configuration.

notes.description: What this build offers and why.

playableClasses.description: The classes the class select screen lets the player confirm; the rest show locked (mw-e01.15).

startScene.description: The scene a new game starts in and the title screen shows behind it (mw-e01.2).

dayLengthRealMinutes.description: Real minutes of sim time in one game day; 60 means a day passes in an hour.

day.description: Day number a new world starts on.

minute.description: Minute of that day a new world starts at (360 = 06:00).

startMinute.description: Minute of the day the phase begins.

phases.description: Phases of the day, ascending by startMinute; the last runs past midnight into the first.

pauseScreens.description: Screen id -> whether it holds the clock while open (the sim already stops while a menu pauses it; this is for screens that leave it running).

default.description: The preset a player who has never chosen one plays on.

damageTaken.description: Scales damage the player takes (1 = as authored). Allowed ranges are checked against the sim's.

damageDealt.description: Scales damage the player deals. Allowed ranges are checked against the sim's.

detectionSpeed.description: Scales how fast enemy awareness builds; lower is more forgiving. Allowed ranges are checked against the sim's.

parryWindow.description: Scales the parry timing window; higher is more forgiving. Allowed ranges are checked against the sim's.

dodgeWindow.description: Scales dodge invulnerability frames; higher is more forgiving. Allowed ranges are checked against the sim's.

fallDamage.description: Scales fall, crush and hazard damage; 0 turns it off. Allowed ranges are checked against the sim's.

puzzleHints.description: Scales puzzle hint availability; 0 turns hints off. Allowed ranges are checked against the sim's.

searchDuration.description: Scales how long a creature searches at the last known position; lower is more forgiving. Allowed ranges are checked against the sim's.
